name: io.github.cphoskins/notion-full-mcp
description: Full-featured Notion MCP server with deep page reading, surgical editing, snapshot/restore, and all block types

environment_variables.name: NOTION_API_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Your Notion integration API token (starts with ntn_)

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search Notion pages by title

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Notion pages and/or databases

tools.name: get_page_info
tools.description: Get page metadata (title, parent, dates, URL)

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new page under a parent page or database

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update a page's title, icon, or archive status

tools.name: move_page
tools.description: Move a page to a new parent

tools.name: read_page_deep
tools.description: Read page with all nested children recursively

tools.name: list_block_children
tools.description: List direct children of a block or page

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Get a single block by ID

tools.name: update_block_text
tools.description: Replace all text in a block

tools.name: find_replace_in_block
tools.description: Find/replace text preserving formatting

tools.name: update_block_rich_text
tools.description: Update block with full rich text specification

tools.name: insert_text_after
tools.description: Insert a text block after a specific block

tools.name: insert_blocks_after
tools.description: Insert multiple blocks after a specific block

tools.name: append_blocks_to_page
tools.description: Append blocks to the end of a page

tools.name: delete_block
tools.description: Delete a block by ID

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a page

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List all comments on a page or block

tools.name: get_database
tools.description: Get database metadata and schema

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Query a database with filters and sorts

tools.name: get_self
tools.description: Get the current authenticated user/bot

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List all workspace users

tools.name: snapshot_page
tools.description: Save complete page structure as JSON snapshot

tools.name: restore_page_from_snapshot
tools.description: Restore page from a snapshot (destructive)
